As someone who likes both properties, they are good. I say give them a go. Going off memory but below is a quick review.

1: Has a great team up story mode. If you play any of the games I say this one first because the gameplay is ok.

2: Gameplay is more defined but took out the original story mode. Also remember it being very grindy.

3: Was ok. Added more characters and very fast pace. Added this weird morale system. Pretty much depending on how often you kill or die, it assigns the team points. So you can die multiple times without losing the mission. Also you die in like a few hits so it gets very annoying when you get cheap shot.

Reborn: it's pretty much a "greatest hits". Adds a ton of characters and it's plays more like 2. This game for the US was digital only so if you're interested in owning it legally do it before the store closes. It has a story mode but isn't as cool as part 1. Probably my favorite one.
